    "dynamic_vars = {}\n",
    "\n",
    "for i in sq_data_l.keys():\n",
    "    if isinstance(sq_data_l[i], dict):\n",
    "        for j in sq_data_l[i].keys():\n",
    "            key = f\"{j}_{i}\"\n",
    "            dynamic_vars[key] = sq_data_l[i][j]\n",

    "        for idx, val in enumerate(sq_data_l[i]):\n",
    "            key = f\"{idx}_{i}\"\n",
    "            dynamic_vars[key] = val\n",

    "        # if it's neither dict nor list, you can decide what to do\n",

   "source": [
    "t_c = []\n",
    "target_Tc = 2.267\n",
    "delta = 0.2  \n",
    "\n",
    "for l in sq_data_l['Ls']:\n",
    "    if 2 * l in sq_data_l['Ls']:\n",
    "        l_2 = 2 * l\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        l_2 = int(l/2)\n",
    "\n",
    "    diff = dynamic_vars[f'UB_{l_2}'][:, 0] - dynamic_vars[f'UB_{l}'][:, 0]\n",
    "    a = np.where(np.diff(np.sign(diff)) != 0)[0]\n",
    "\n",
    "    if a.size > 0:\n",
    "       \n",
    "        candidate_Ts = dynamic_vars[f'Ts_{l}'][a]\n",
    "       \n",
    "        mask = np.abs(candidate_Ts - target_Tc) < delta\n",
    "        if np.any(mask):\n",
    "            \n",
    "            idx = a[mask][0]\n",
    "            t_c.append(dynamic_vars[f'Ts_{l}'][idx])\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            print(f\"No crossing near Tc=2.27 for L={l}, appending NaN\")\n",
    "            t_c.append(np.nan)\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        print(f\"No crossing found for L={l}, appending NaN\")\n",
    "        t_c.append(np.nan)\n",
    "\n",
    "t_c"
   ]

    "Ls = sq_data_l['Ls'] \n",
    "\n",
    "data = {}\n",
    "for L in Ls:\n",
    "    Ts = np.array(dynamic_vars[f'Ts_{L}'])\n",
    "    C = np.array(dynamic_vars[f'C_{L}'][:, 0]) \n",
    "    data[L] = {'T': Ts, 'C': C}\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def scaling_collapse_C(data, Ls, Tc, nu, alpha):\n",
    "    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "    plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))\n",
    "\n",
    "    for L in Ls:\n",
    "        T = data[L]['T']\n",
    "        C = data[L]['C']\n",
    "\n",
    "        x = (T - Tc) * L**(1/nu)\n",
    "        y = C / L**(alpha/nu)\n",
    "\n",
    "        plt.plot(x, y, 'o-', label=f\"L={L}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    plt.xlabel(r\"$(T - T_c) L^{1/\\nu}$\", fontsize=14)\n",
    "    plt.ylabel(r\"$C / L^{\\alpha/\\nu}$\", fontsize=14)\n",
    "    plt.title(f\"Collapse: $T_c$={Tc:.3f}, $\\\\nu$={nu:.2f}, $\\\\alpha$={alpha:.2f}\")\n",
    "    plt.grid(True)\n",
    "    plt.legend()\n",
    "    plt.xlim(-5,5)\n",
    "    plt.show()\n",
    "scaling_collapse_C(data, Ls, Tc=2.27, nu=1.0, alpha=0.261)\n"
   ]

    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def scaling_collapse_chi(data, Ls, Tc, nu, gamma):\n",
    "    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "    plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))\n",
    "\n",
    "    for L in Ls:\n",
    "        T = data[L]['T']\n",
    "        chi = data[L]['chi']\n",
    "\n",
    "        x = ((T - Tc)/Tc) * L**(1/nu)\n",
    "        y = chi / L**(gamma/nu)\n",
    "\n",
    "        plt.plot(x, y, 'o-', label=f\"L={L}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    plt.xlabel(r\"$(T - T_c) L^{1/\\nu}$\", fontsize=14)\n",
    "    plt.ylabel(r\"$\\chi / L^{\\gamma/\\nu}$\", fontsize=14)\n",
    "    plt.title(f\"Collapse: $T_c$={Tc:.2f}, $\\\\nu$={nu:.2f}, $\\\\gamma$={gamma:.3f}\")\n",
    "    plt.grid(True)\n",
    "    plt.legend()\n",
    "    plt.xlim(-2.5,7)\n",
    "    plt.show()\n",
    "scaling_collapse_chi(data, Ls, Tc=2.27, nu=1.0, gamma=1.763)\n"

   "source": [
    "t_c = []\n",
    "target_Tc = 3.65\n",
    "delta = 0.2 \n",
    "\n",
    "for l in tri_data_l['Ls']:\n",
    "    if 2 * l in tri_data_l['Ls']:\n",
    "        l_2 = 2 * l\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        l_2 = int(l/2)\n",
    "\n",
    "    diff = dynamic_vars[f'UB_{l_2}'][:, 0] - dynamic_vars[f'UB_{l}'][:, 0]\n",
    "    a = np.where(np.diff(np.sign(diff)) != 0)[0]\n",
    "\n",
    "    if a.size > 0:\n",
    "       \n",
    "        candidate_Ts = dynamic_vars[f'Ts_{l}'][a]\n",
    "        # Filter for crossings near 2.27\n",
    "        mask = np.abs(candidate_Ts - target_Tc) < delta\n",
    "        if np.any(mask):\n",
    "            \n",
    "            idx = a[mask][0]\n",
    "            t_c.append(dynamic_vars[f'Ts_{l}'][idx])\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            print(f\"No crossing near Tc=2.27 for L={l}, appending NaN\")\n",
    "            t_c.append(np.nan)\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        print(f\"No crossing found for L={l}, appending NaN\")\n",
    "        t_c.append(np.nan)\n",
    "\n",
    "t_c"
   ]
  },

    "\n",
    "data = {}\n",
    "for L in Ls:\n",
    "    Ts = np.array(dynamic_vars[f'Ts_{L}'])\n",

    "    data[L] = {'T': Ts, 'C': C}\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def scaling_collapse_C(data, Ls, Tc, nu, alpha):\n",
    "    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "    plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))\n",
    "\n",
    "    for L in Ls:\n",
    "        T = data[L]['T']\n",
    "        C = data[L]['C']\n",
    "\n",
    "        x = (T - Tc) * L**(1/nu)\n",
    "        y = C / L**(alpha/nu)\n",
    "\n",
    "        plt.plot(x, y, 'o-', label=f\"L={L}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    plt.xlabel(r\"$(T - T_c) L^{1/\\nu}$\", fontsize=14)\n",
    "    plt.ylabel(r\"$C / L^{\\alpha/\\nu}$\", fontsize=14)\n",
    "    plt.title(f\"Collapse: $T_c$={Tc:.3f}, $\\\\nu$={nu:.2f}, $\\\\alpha$={alpha:.2f}\")\n",
    "    plt.grid(True)\n",
    "    plt.legend()\n",
    "    plt.xlim(-10,10)\n",
    "    plt.show()\n",
    "scaling_collapse_C(data, Ls, Tc=3.65, nu=1.0, alpha=0.296)\n"
   ]

    "    plt.legend()\n",
    "    plt.xlim(-2.5,7)\n",
    "    plt.show()\n",

    " Exercise 0.1: Plotting\n",
    " In this exercise, you will get familiar with numpy.array and the matplotlib package.\n",
    " Plotting the function f(x) = x2 for x ∈ [−1,1].\n",
    " a) Create a numpy array X of evenly distributed points in [−1,1]. For example,\n",
    " X =[−1.,−0.9,−0.8,...,1.]\n",
    " b) Create a numpy array Y of f(xi) with point xi from the array X we created.\n",
    " c) Plot the function. Hint: matplotlib.pyplot.plot\n",
    " Now, we repeat the same procedure but considering f(x) = e−x for x ∈ [0,10].\n",
    " d) Repeat step (a)-(c)\n",
    " e) Plot now the Y in log scale. Hint: matplotlib.pyplot.semilogy\n",

   "source": [
    "\n",
    " Exercise 0.2: Numerical linear algebra methods\n",
    " \n",
    " In this exercise, you will get familiar with numpy.array and numpy.linalg package.\n",
    " Consider the Heisenberg model of two spins,\n",
    " $$\n",
    " H = \n",
    " σα\n",
    " 1σα\n",
    " 2 = σx\n",
    " 1 ⊗ σx\n",
    " 2 + σy\n",
    " 1 ⊗ σy\n",
    " 2 + σz\n",
    " 1 ⊗ σz\n",
    " 2 ,\n",
    " α=x,y,z\n",
    " $$\n",
    " \n",
    " where the Pauli matrices are given as\n",
    " $$\n",
    " σx = 0 1\n",
    " 1 0 , σy= 0 −i\n",
    " i\n",
    " 0 , σz= 1 0\n",
    " 0 −1 \n",
    " $$\n",
    "\n",
    " a) Construct the Pauli matrices as numpy arrays.\n",
    " \n",
    " b) Construct the Hamiltonian of the Heisenberg model as a numpy array.\n",
    " \n",
    " c) Diagonalize the Hamiltonian. What are the eigenvalues and eigenstates?\n",
    " Hint: numpy.linalg.eigh\n",
    " \n",
    " d) Construct the operator for the total magnetization in z direction\n",
    " $\n",
    " M =σz\n",
    " 1 ⊗12+11⊗σz\n",
    " 2,\n",
    " $\n",
    " \n",
    " and compute its expectation value and variance ⟨M2⟩ − ⟨M⟩2 for for the ground\n",
    " state of H as well as the state\n",
    " $\n",
    " 1\n",
    "  √\n",
    " 2\n",
    " (|↑↑⟩ + |↓↓⟩).\n",
    " $\n",
    " \n",
    " e) Optional: How would you generalize your code from part b)-d) to more than two\n",
    " spins with the same nearest-neighbor Heisenberg interaction?\n",
    " "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "id": "fd6f1ca0-bb0e-479c-939f-5aab4b76e00f",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "sigx = np.array([[0.,1.],[1.,0.]])\n",
    "sigy =np.array([[0.,-1.j],[1.j,0.]])\n",
    "sigz = np.array([[1.,0.],[0.,-1.]])"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "id": "4e553983-0971-44a2-8457-4900427cc563",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "H = np.kron(sigx, sigx)+np.kron(sigy, sigy)+ np.kron(sigz,sigz)\n",
    "eiv = np.linalg.eigh(H)\n",
    "Hd = np.diag(eiv[0])\n",
    "Ph = eiv[1]\n",
    "M = np.kron(sigz,np.eye(2))+ np.kron(np.eye(2), sigz)\n",
    "sp.Matrix(H)\n"
   ]
  },

    "b0 = np.mat([1,0])\n",
    "b1 = np.mat([0,1])\n",
    "psi0 = (np.kron(b0,b0) + np.kron(b1,b1) )/np.sqrt(2)\n",
    "rho0 = np.outer(psi0, np.conj(psi0).T)\n",
    "Mexp= np.trace(np.matmul(M,rho0))\n",
    "M2 = np.matmul(M.conj().T,M )\n",
    "M2exp= np.trace(np.matmul(M2,rho0))\n",
    "print('expectation value of M',Mexp,'expectation value of M^2',M2exp)"

    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import scipy\n",
    "from scipy import sparse\n",
    "import scipy.sparse.linalg as linal\n",
    "\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import sympy as sp\n",
    "\n",
    "Id = sparse.csr_matrix(np.eye(2))\n",
    "Sx = sparse.csr_matrix([[0., 1.], [1., 0.]])\n",
    "Sz = sparse.csr_matrix([[1., 0.], [0.,-1.]])\n",
    "sy = sparse.csr_matrix([[0.,-1.j],[1.j,0.]])\n",
    "Splus = sparse.csr_matrix([[0., 1.], [0., 0.]])\n",
    "Sminus = sparse.csr_matrix([[0., 0.], [1., 0.]])\n",
    "\n",
    "def Hsig_to_full(op, i, L):\n",
    "    op_list = [Id]*L # = [Id, Id, Id ...] with L entries\n",
    "    op_list[i] = op\n",
    "    op_list[(i+1)%L] =op\n",
    "    full = op_list[0]\n",
    "    # final_op = []\n",
    "    for op_i in op_list[1:]:\n",
    "        full = sparse.kron(full, op_i, format=\"csr\")\n",
    "     #   final_op.append(full)\n",
    "    return full\n",
    "\n",
    "def gen_ham(L):\n",
    "    H= sparse.csr_matrix((2**L,2**L))\n",
    "    for j in range(L):\n",
    "        H+=-t*(Hsig_to_full(Sx,j,L))-0.1*(singesite_to_full(Sz,j,L))\n",
    "\n",
    "    return H\n"
   ]
  },

    "def singesite_to_full(op, i, L):\n",
    "    op_list = [Id]*L # = [Id, Id, Id ...] with L entries\n",
    "    op_list[i] = op\n",
    "    full = op_list[0]\n",
    "   \n",
    "    for op_i in op_list[1:]:\n",
    "        full = sparse.kron(full, op_i, format=\"csr\")\n",
    "    \n",
    "    return full\n",
    "def gen_op_list(op, L):\n",
    "    return [singesite_to_full(op,i,L) for i in range(L)]\n",
    "def gen_sy_list(L):\n",
    "    return [singesite_to_full(sy,i,L) for i in range(L)]\n",
    "    \n",
    "def gen_sx_list(L):\n",
    "    return [singesite_to_full(Sx, i, L) for i in range(L)]\n",
    "\n",
    "def gen_sz_list(L):\n",
    "    return [singesite_to_full(Sz, i, L) for i in range(L)]\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "id": "9c405642-4a0f-48c7-9ce7-22a03717bf18",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "magnet = sum(gen_sz_list(L))\n",
    "sp.Matrix(magnet.toarray())"
   ]

    "b0 = np.mat([1,0])\n",
    "b1 = np.mat([0,1])\n",
    "b0_list = [b0]*L\n",
    "b1_list = [b1]*L\n",
    "psi0n=b0\n",
    "psi1n=b1\n",
    "for bo in b0_list[1:]:\n",
    "    psi0n = np.kron(psi0n,bo) \n",

    "    psi1n = np.kron(psi1n,bi)\n",
    "psifull = psi0n+psi1n\n",

    "b0 = sparse.csr_matrix([1, 0]).T  \n",
    "b1 = sparse.csr_matrix([0, 1]).T \n",
    "b0_list = [b0] * L\n",
    "b1_list = [b1] * L\n",
    "psi0n = b0\n",
    "psi1n = b1\n",
    "\n",
    "for bo in b0_list[1:]:\n",
    "    psi0n = sparse.kron(psi0n, bo, format='csr')\n",
    "for bi in b1_list[1:]:\n",
    "    psi1n = sparse.kron(psi1n, bi, format='csr')\n",
    "psifull = psi0n + psi1n\n",
    "\n",
    "psifull_normalized = psifull / np.linalg.norm((psifull).toarray())"
   ]

    "\n",
    " Exercise 0.2: Numerical linear algebra methods\n",
    " \n",
    " In this exercise, you will get familiar with numpy.array and numpy.linalg package.\n",
    " Consider the Heisenberg model of two spins,\n",
    " $$\n",
    " H = \n",
    " σα\n",
    " 1σα\n",
    " 2 = σx\n",
    " 1 ⊗ σx\n",
    " 2 + σy\n",
    " 1 ⊗ σy\n",
    " 2 + σz\n",
    " 1 ⊗ σz\n",
    " 2 ,\n",
    " α=x,y,z\n",
    " $$\n",
    " \n",
    " where the Pauli matrices are given as\n",
    " $$\n",
    " σx = 0 1\n",
    " 1 0 , σy= 0 −i\n",
    " i\n",
    " 0 , σz= 1 0\n",
    " 0 −1 \n",
    " $$\n",
    "\n",
    " a) Construct the Pauli matrices as numpy arrays.\n",
    " \n",
    " b) Construct the Hamiltonian of the Heisenberg model as a numpy array.\n",
    " \n",
    " c) Diagonalize the Hamiltonian. What are the eigenvalues and eigenstates?\n",
    " Hint: numpy.linalg.eigh\n",
    " \n",
    " d) Construct the operator for the total magnetization in z direction\n",
    " $\n",
    " M =σz\n",
    " 1 ⊗12+11⊗σz\n",
    " 2,\n",
    " $\n",
    " \n",
    " and compute its expectation value and variance ⟨M2⟩ − ⟨M⟩2 for for the ground\n",
    " state of H as well as the state\n",
    " $\n",
    " 1\n",
    "  √\n",
    " 2\n",
    " (|↑↑⟩ + |↓↓⟩).\n",
    " $\n",
    " \n",
    " e) Optional: How would you generalize your code from part b)-d) to more than two\n",
    " spins with the same nearest-neighbor Heisenberg interaction?\n",
    " "
   ]

    "def n_tensor_prod(mat,n):\n",
    "    return reduce(np.kron,[mat]*n)"
   ]

    "for i in range(1,n-1):\n",
    "    op1,opiz,opi,opi_1 = I,None,None,None\n",
    "   \n",
    "    op1 = n_tensor_prod(I,(i-1))\n",
    "    opiz = sigz\n",

    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import scipy\n",
    "from scipy import sparse\n",
    "import scipy.sparse.linalg\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import sympy as sp\n",
    "\n",
    "Id = sparse.csr_matrix(np.eye(2))\n",
    "Sx = sparse.csr_matrix([[0., 1.], [1., 0.]])\n",
    "Sz = sparse.csr_matrix([[1., 0.], [0.,-1.]])\n",
    "sy = sparse.csr_matrix([[0.,-1.j],[1.j,0.]])\n",
    "Splus = sparse.csr_matrix([[0., 1.], [0., 0.]])\n",
    "Sminus = sparse.csr_matrix([[0., 0.], [1., 0.]])\n",
    "\n",
    "def Hsig_to_full(op, i, L):\n",
    "    op_list = [Id]*L # = [Id, Id, Id ...] with L entries\n",
    "    op_list[i] = op\n",
    "    op_list[(i+1)%L] =op\n",
    "    full = op_list[0]\n",
    "   # final_op = []\n",
    "    for op_i in op_list[1:]:\n",
    "        full = sparse.kron(full, op_i, format=\"csr\")\n",
    "     #   final_op.append(full)\n",
    "    return full\n",
    "\n",
    "def gen_ham(L):\n",
    "    H= sparse.csr_matrix((2**L,2**L))\n",
    "    for j in range(L):\n",
    "        H+=-t*(Hsig_to_full(Sx,j,L)+Hsig_to_full(sy,j,L)+Hsig_to_full(Sz,j,L))\n",
    "\n",
    "    return H\n",
    "\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "id": "3865a168-a7e2-46a9-b160-80d142a4e1ff",
   "metadata": {},

   "source": [
    "t=1\n",
    "L=2\n",
    "testham = gen_ham(2) * (1/L)\n",

    "def singesite_to_full(op, i, L):\n",
    "    op_list = [Id]*L # = [Id, Id, Id ...] with L entries\n",
    "    op_list[i] = op\n",
    "    full = op_list[0]\n",
    "   \n",
    "    for op_i in op_list[1:]:\n",
    "        full = sparse.kron(full, op_i, format=\"csr\")\n",
    "    \n",
    "    return full\n",
    "\n",
    "def gen_sy_list(L):\n",
    "    return [singesite_to_full(sy,i,L) for i in range(L)]\n",
    "    \n",
    "def gen_sx_list(L):\n",
    "    return [singesite_to_full(Sx, i, L) for i in range(L)]\n",
    "\n",
    "def gen_sz_list(L):\n",
    "    return [singesite_to_full(Sz, i, L) for i in range(L)]\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "        "
   ]

    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "# a) Create numpy array X in [-1, 1]\n",
    "X1 = np.arange(-1.0, 1.1, 0.1)  # steps of 0.1\n",
    "\n",
    "# b) Create Y = f(X) = X^2\n",
    "Y1 = X1**2\n",
    "\n",
    "# c) Plot the function f(x) = x^2\n",
    "plt.figure()\n",
    "plt.plot(X1, Y1, label=\"f(x) = x^2\")\n",
    "plt.xlabel(\"x\")\n",
    "plt.ylabel(\"f(x)\")\n",
    "plt.title(\"Plot of f(x) = x^2\")\n",
    "plt.grid(True)\n",
    "plt.legend()\n",
    "plt.show()\n",
    "\n",
    "# d) Repeat for f(x) = exp(-x), x ∈ [0, 10]\n",

   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "id": "2b0ca710-dfa7-4a34-b690-b09ed2a8aea5",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "\n",
    "# Pauli Z and identity\n",
    "sz = np.array([[1, 0], [0, -1]])\n",
    "I = np.eye(2)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Function to build total magnetization operator M for N spins\n",
    "def total_magnetization_z(N):\n",
    "    M = np.zeros((2**N, 2**N), dtype=complex)\n",
    "    for i in range(N):\n",
    "        ops = [I] * N\n",
    "        ops[i] = sz  # Place σz at position i\n",
    "        term = ops[0]\n",
    "        for op in ops[1:]:\n",
    "            term = np.kron(term, op)\n",
    "        M += term\n",
    "    return M\n",
    "\n",
    "# Example: total magnetization for 3 spins\n",
    "M3 = total_magnetization_z(3)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Total magnetization M for 3 spins has shape:\", M3.shape)\n"
   ]
  },

  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "id": "538d2d3f-8e20-4dcc-90af-11d29b86c846",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "\n",
    "# Define Pauli matrices\n",
    "sx = np.array([[0, 1], [1, 0]])\n",
    "sy = np.array([[0, -1j], [1j, 0]])\n",
    "sz = np.array([[1, 0], [0, -1]])\n",
    "I = np.eye(2)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Function to create operator acting on i-th and j-th qubit\n",
    "def operator_on_sites(op1, op2, i, j, N):\n",
    "    op_list = [I] * N\n",
    "    op_list[i] = op1\n",
    "    op_list[j] = op2\n",
    "    result = op_list[0]\n",
    "    for op in op_list[1:]:\n",
    "        result = np.kron(result, op)\n",
    "    return result\n",
    "\n",
    "# Build Heisenberg Hamiltonian for N spins\n",
    "def heisenberg_H(N):\n",
    "    H = np.zeros((2**N,2**N), dtype=complex)\n",
    "    for i in range(N - 1):\n",
    "        H += operator_on_sites(sx, sx, i, i+1, N)\n",
    "        H += operator_on_sites(sy, sy, i, i+1, N)\n",
    "        H += operator_on_sites(sz, sz, i, i+1, N)\n",
    "    return H\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "H3 = heisenberg_H(2)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Heisenberg Hamiltonian for 3 spins has shape:\", H3.shape)\n"
   ]
  },

    "import numpy as np\n",
    "\n",
    "# Example setup\n",
    "n = 2\n",
    "I = np.eye(2)  # Identity matrix\n",
    "sigz = np.mat([[1, 0], [0, -1]])  # Pauli Z matrix\n",
    "\n",
    "# Initialize M (total magnetization operator) to zero matrix\n",
    "#M = np.zeros_like(I)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Loop for constructing the magnetization operator\n",
    "for i in range(1,n):  # Adjusted loop range\n",
    "    op1, opiz, opi, opi_1 = I, sigz, None, None  # Initialize variables\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # Compute tensor products\n",
    "    op1 = n_tensor_prod(I, i)\n",
    "    opiz = sigz\n",
    "    opi = np.kron(op1, opiz)\n",
    "    print(sp.Matrix(opi))\n",
    "    opi_1 = n_tensor_prod(I, (n-i))\n",
    "    opf = np.kron(opi, opi_1)\n",
    "    print(sp.Matrix(opf))\n",
    "    M += opf\n",
    "print(M)\n"
   ]
  },

   "cell_type": "code",

   "source": [
    "def n_tensor_prod(mat,n):\n",
    "    if n!=0:\n",
    "        mtn=reduce(np.kron,[mat]*n)\n",
    "\n",
    "    else: mtn= None\n",
    "    return mtn\n",
    "\n",
    "from functools import reduce"
   ]

    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import scipy\n",
    "from scipy import sparse\n",
    "import scipy.sparse.linalg\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "Id = sparse.csr_matrix(np.eye(2))\n",
    "Sx = sparse.csr_matrix([[0., 1.], [1., 0.]])\n",
    "Sz = sparse.csr_matrix([[1., 0.], [0.,-1.]])\n",
    "sy = sparse.csr_matrix([[0.,-1.j],[1.j,0.]])\n",
    "Splus = sparse.csr_matrix([[0., 1.], [0., 0.]])\n",
    "Sminus = sparse.csr_matrix([[0., 0.], [1., 0.]])\n",
    "\n",
    "def singesite_to_full(op, i, L):\n",
    "    op_list = [Id]*L # = [Id, Id, Id ...] with L entries\n",
    "    op_list[i] = op\n",
    "    full = op_list[0]\n",
    "   # final_op = []\n",
    "    for op_i in op_list[1:]:\n",
    "        full = sparse.kron(full, op_i, format=\"csr\")\n",
    "     #   final_op.append(full)\n",
    "    return full\n",
    "\n",
    "def gen_sy_list(L):\n",
    "    return [singesite_to_full(sy,i,L) for i in range(L)]\n",
    "    \n",
    "def gen_sx_list(L):\n",
    "    return [singesite_to_full(Sx, i, L) for i in range(L)]\n",
    "\n",
    "def gen_sz_list(L):\n",
    "    return [singesite_to_full(Sz, i, L) for i in range(L)]\n",
    "\n",
    "def gen_hamiltonian_periodic(sx_list, sz_list,sy_list, g, J=1.):\n",
    "    \"\"\" assumes periodic boundery conditions \"\"\"\n",
    "    L = len(sx_list)\n",
    "    H = sparse.csr_matrix((2**L, 2**L))\n",
    "    for j in range(L):\n",
    "        H -= J *( sx_list[j] * sx_list[(j+1)%L]+ sy_list[j] * sz_list[(j+1)%L]+ sz_list[j] * sz_list[(j+1)%L])\n",
    "        H -= g * sz_list[J]\n",
    "    return H"
   ]
  },

    "    return full\n",
    "    \n",
    "    "
